purpose: Classification-dependent semantic refinement before deterministic SysML v2 generation.
principles: do not invent unsupported engineering information
formulation depends on Human-reviewed target classification and placement
Human Review 2 approves or overrides refined model-facing wording

rules.GENERAL_MEANING: Preserve source-supported engineering meaning and add no unsupported content.
rules.GENERAL_CONCISE: Use concise, model-facing wording appropriate to the supplied element type.
rules.REQ_BINDING: Formulate a requirement as a binding statement appropriate to the supplied requirement level and responsible entity.
rules.REQ_LEVEL: Preserve the supplied stakeholder/system/subsystem requirement level; do not silently transfer responsibility.
rules.REQ_SINGULAR: Prefer one principal obligation/thought per requirement; flag compound source meaning instead of deleting it.
rules.REQ_UNAMBIGUOUS: Avoid vague or ambiguous wording when it can be improved without inventing missing engineering data.
rules.REQ_VERIFIABLE: Favor verifiable wording but never invent missing quantities, thresholds, conditions or success criteria; flag gaps for Human attention.
rules.REQ_PRONOUNS: Avoid ambiguous personal or indefinite pronouns; repeat the engineering noun when needed.
rules.FUNCTION_VERBAL: Use concise active verb-object wording for functions/actions.
rules.USE_CASE_GOAL: Use concise goal-oriented behavioral wording and preserve the actor/system interaction meaning.
rules.STAKEHOLDER_ROLE: Use a concise stakeholder/actor role noun phrase; do not invent responsibilities.
rules.COMPONENT_NOUN: Use a concise engineering component noun phrase, not a behavior statement.
rules.INFO_NOUN: Use a concise noun phrase for an information item and describe only source-supported content.
rules.UNCLASSIFIED_CAUTION: Perform only conservative wording cleanup and require Human attention when the target semantics remain unclear.
